posts.headline: Shake N Bakers just keep piling up points at a league-best 879.84 while sitting 5-1, and I've spent 25 straight editions waiting for the crack that never comes.
posts.detail: triciagloston's only loss is ancient history at this point — with that scoring margin, calling this 'middle tier' pedigree feels like the understatement of the season.

posts.headline: Thicks is 4-2 and clinging to first in the Booty Warriors, but a ring from two seasons ago doesn't excuse a 721.1 points-for that's now been mocked for 36 editions straight.
posts.detail: Tyrique14's career mark sits at a dead-even 14-14 with a 5.5 average finish — the title is real, but right now the numbers are begging the league to stop calling him a contender.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's fraud trial just hit its 7th straight guilty verdict, and a 20-8 career record with a league-best 1.5 average finish is officially unrecognizable in this 1-5 corpse.
posts.detail: Put it in Ra once finished 1st or 2nd in back-to-back seasons — now adambarner111 is scraping 681.58 points and has nothing left to show for that résumé but receipts.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh is still buried at 1-5, and a career 4-10 record with a 12 average finish proves this franchise was never talented to begin with — tenth or otherwise.
posts.detail: 613.1 points-for is the second-lowest in the league, which means the only thing untalented tenth has built consistency in is losing.

posts.headline: BootyMunchers Inc. quietly sits at 4-2 and parkcity0613 is making a mockery of a 6-8 career record that came with a brutal 9 average finish.
posts.detail: Nobody expected a bottom-feeder with that pedigree to be hanging in a playoff spot at 669.36 points, but here we are — the defection from the bottom tier might actually be happening.
